description: This script scans a project directory for files that contain suspicious references to 'firecrawl' in order to identify potential web-fetch boundary violations related to 'firecrawl' fetch logic. It imports utility functions, processes files recursively, and reports violations either as JSON or console messages.

methods.name: collectWebFetchProviderBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Recursively scans 'src' directory for files containing suspicious 'firecrawl' related patterns, reporting violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes the violation collection and outputs results in JSON or plain text format.
